description: Explicit, reviewed file-level exceptions for style-audit heuristics. Matches remain visible as classified exceptions in reports; they are not counted as actionable design-system debt.

nativeControlRecreations.reason: Specialized virtual-keyboard keys require keyboard-specific interaction and repeat behavior.
The remaining native button is a pointer-driven drag handle whose touch-action and Framer Motion drag controls must live on the interactive element.
The multi-day event block is a specialized absolutely positioned calendar span with runtime width, selection, and double-click edit behavior.
